say:1:1122538001:1.text: You're right on time! I got a job for you.
say:1:1122538001:1.source_cn: 来得正好，有件委托要交给你。
say:1:1122538001:1.male: You're right on time! I got a job for you.
say:1:1122538001:1.female: You're right on time! I got a job for you.

say:2:1122538002:1.text: There's a Mauler clan in the Crimson Highlands that lost some baby terrabirds. I need someone to go over and investigate.
